svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The durable layer of a persistent agent team: per-agent long-term memory, a shared team ledger, per-agent session stores, and a shared task board
svg.desc: A four-cell panel diagram. Top left: per-agent long-term memory, MEMORY.md, append-only, curated and human-readable, private to one agent with one writer. Top right: shared team memory, SHARED.md, a single append-only team ledger; every agent reads it at session start and any agent may append to it under a claim lease. Bottom left: per-agent session stores holding durable chat history in SQLite, local to each agent. Bottom right: a shared task board of claims recording who owns which file right now, which prevents two writers on one file. A footer states that memory is the continuity layer, not a cache, and that the shared ledger holds team-scoped truth — decisions with provenance, file ownership and standing conventions — as a ledger, not a scratchpad.
svg.text: The durable layer
Every agent reads it at session start. Memory is the continuity layer — not a cache.

MEMORY.md · append-only · curated, human-readable
Private to one agent — one writer
the agent's own durable memory; tiers per §10
Shared team memory
SHARED.md · one append-only team ledger
Read by all · appended to under a claim lease
team-scoped truth; never per-persona scratch
Per-agent session stores
Durable chat history (SQLite)
Local to each agent · survives restart
what happened, kept verbatim
Shared task board
Claims: who owns which file, right now
Two writers on one file is a data-loss bug
teams must prevent it by construction
Memory is the continuity layer, not a cache.
The shared ledger holds team-scoped truth — decisions with provenance, file ownership, standing conventions.
A ledger, not a scratchpad. Recency orders the per-agent tiers (§10); the team scopes this one.
